description: Replace mod-based sharding with a consistent-hash ring (virtual nodes) so removing one node only remaps that node's own keys
prompts: Create src/HashRing.php defining namespace App and class HashRing. The constructor __construct(array $nodes, int $replicas) places $replicas virtual points per physical node around a ring, hashed via crc32("$node:$i") for each virtual point. getNode(string $key): string hashes the key onto the ring and returns the node owning the next virtual point clockwise (wrapping around). addNode(string $node): void and removeNode(string $node): void update the ring in place. Do not use a plain modulo of the key's hash directly against the node list - that reshuffles almost every key when a node is added or removed.

reference_solution.src/HashRing.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class HashRing
{
    private int $replicas;
    private array $ring = []; // point (int) -> node

    public function __construct(array $nodes, int $replicas)
    {
        $this->replicas = $replicas;
        foreach ($nodes as $node) {
            $this->addNode($node);
        }
    }

    public function addNode(string $node): void
    {
        for ($i = 0; $i < $this->replicas; $i++) {
            $this->ring[crc32("$node:$i")] = $node;
        }
        ksort($this->ring);
    }

    public function removeNode(string $node): void
    {
        for ($i = 0; $i < $this->replicas; $i++) {
            unset($this->ring[crc32("$node:$i")]);
        }
        ksort($this->ring);
    }

    public function getNode(string $key): string
    {
        $point = crc32($key);
        foreach ($this->ring as $p => $node) {
            if ($p >= $point) {
                return $node;
            }
        }
        return reset($this->ring);
    }
}

files.src/HashRing.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class HashRing
{
    private array $nodes;

    public function __construct(array $nodes, int $replicas)
    {
        $this->nodes = array_values($nodes);
    }

    public function addNode(string $node): void
    {
        $this->nodes[] = $node;
    }

    public function removeNode(string $node): void
    {
        $this->nodes = array_values(array_filter($this->nodes, fn($n) => $n !== $node));
    }

    public function getNode(string $key): string
    {
        $idx = crc32($key) % count($this->nodes);
        return $this->nodes[$idx];
    }
}

<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/HashRing.php';

final class HashRingTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testEveryKeyMapsToACurrentNode(): void
    {
        $ring = new \App\HashRing(["a", "b", "c"], 50);
        for ($i = 0; $i < 200; $i++) {
            $node = $ring->getNode("key-$i");
            $this->assertContains($node, ["a", "b", "c"]);
        }
    }

    public function testDeterministic(): void
    {
        $ring = new \App\HashRing(["a", "b", "c"], 50);
        $this->assertSame($ring->getNode("stable-key"), $ring->getNode("stable-key"));
    }

    public function testRemovingANodeOnlyMovesThatNodesOwnKeys(): void
    {
        $nodes = ["n0", "n1", "n2", "n3", "n4"];
        $ring = new \App\HashRing($nodes, 100);
        $keys = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < 1000; $i++) { $keys[] = "key-$i"; }
        $before = [];
        foreach ($keys as $k) { $before[$k] = $ring->getNode($k); }

        $ring->removeNode("n2");

        $moved = 0;
        foreach ($keys as $k) {
            $after = $ring->getNode($k);
            if ($after !== $before[$k]) {
                $moved++;
                $this->assertSame("n2", $before[$k]);
            }
            $this->assertNotSame("n2", $after);
        }
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $moved);
    }
}
